description: Fetch one community entry WITH its payload (the dev-defined JSON), whatever its status, plus its user reports (open count, count by reason, and each report with an opaque reporter id). Stats carry favorites, rating, reviews and votes (upvotes, downvotes, score = upvotes − downvotes; a banned user's votes do not count). Who voted is not shown.

env.description: Whose data: "pro" (the users', default) or "pre" (the app's pre, its own users and data unless it plays with pro's)

locale.description: Show title/summary in this language when the entry has it

name: neblla_get_community_entry
